prompt: A cumulative frequency graph shows the marks of 80 students. It passes through the point (35, 40), meaning 40 students scored 35 or less. Estimate the median mark.
explanation: The median is the middle value. With 80 students, read the graph at a cumulative frequency of 80 ÷ 2 = 40, which gives 35 marks.
hint: Read the graph halfway up the total frequency.
